decision_source: Owner's 2026-09-29 answer to the exact one-question review: Approve exact packet
authorized_scope: Exact two-product EarthExplorer full-bundle intake, dependency-ordered implementation and synthetic tests, public CI gate, final no-payload preflight, bounded browser requests, container-only verification, non-Git no-replace custody, and sanitized terminal publication as stated in the proposal.
request_budget: At most one initial browser download per exact product and at most one conditional distinct byte-zero recovery per same product only for a clearly classified transport or local persistence failure under unchanged source, rights, terms, and custody conditions. No retry for content identity, rights, security, or unexplained verification failure.
explicit_exclusions: No token or credential storage/exposure, terms acceptance, paid action, M2M API, alternate host, source substitution, or unbounded retry.
No TIFF header or pixel QA, AOI mask, registration, baseline, change analysis, interpretation, or attribution.
No ArcGIS raster map, derived-pixel release, or scientific publication.
execution_gates: Exact bound-file hashes must still match before control integration.
Synthetic tests and public default-branch CI must pass before any real request.
Final no-payload source, rights, browser, path, free-space, collision, and receipt preflight must pass before each browser request.
